sources.summary: Crossing Grounds: Art, Design, and Technology brings together 16 research projects by 22 artists, architects, designers, scientists, engineers, and technologists from across the Georgia Institute of Technology at the Korea Foundation Gallery in Seoul. Co-curated by Hyojin Kwon and Birney Robert, with Santana Nash as assistant curator, the exhibition explores how emerging technologies are reshaping the ways we create, perceive, and inhabit the world. Spanning architecture, robotics, artificial intelligence, material science, digital fabrication, interactive media, and music, the works examine what happens when tools, materials, and forms of knowledge move across disciplinary boundaries.
